ruleDefinitions.name: Chopper Webshell Process Pattern
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects patterns found in process executions cause by China Chopper like tiny (ASPX) webshells

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&ipconfig\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&quser\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&whoami\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&c\\:\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&cd\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&dir\\&echo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&echo\\ \\[E\\].*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&echo\\ \\[S\\].*")))
